title: Too Good
text: First job for the new lab: the growth pods' own diagnostics. The report comes back flagged. Field-grade gene printing, closed-loop nutrient synthesis, self-healing seals. "This isn't wartime tech. Nobody on a dying Earth built this." The archive dates the design to the year we launched.

choices.label: Keep digging
choices.reply: Logged. The lab will look at the pods again when it has time.
